runtime: local workerd with actual Cloudflare Workflows engine and isolated Neon gate PostgreSQL
observations: Every query step opens a distinct Prisma client and records disposal before the durable wait. No PostgreSQL query occurs while parked.

An injected lost DO acknowledgement retains the obligation, registers a Maintenance retry and eventually acknowledges the same obligation.

fixtureCleanup: Tagged users/workspaces/projects/dispatch rows deleted; no epoch mutation.
